description: This file defines the SplashActivity class that manages the splash screen behavior for the app, utilizing Android's SplashScreen API for Android 12+ and fallback for earlier versions. It handles timing, visual consistency, and navigation to the main activity.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: Activity that displays a branded splash screen using Android 12+ SplashScreen API with fallback for earlier versions, then navigates to MainActivity after 3 seconds.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the splash activity, installs splash screen, sets content view, and manages timing for transition to main activity.

methods.name: navigateToMain
methods.description: Handles navigation from SplashActivity to MainActivity after the splash duration.
